title: The Other side of the river
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：other　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 other 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the craftsman wrote of ① an other side of the river in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so other that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the other ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the other side of the river that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too other to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the other ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an other reason for the delay, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as other as the reason for the delay they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was other or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something other, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite other; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the other ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, twice over, she wrote of another other side of the river in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less other than anybody had expected. ⑩ The other reason for the delay that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the other ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 别（前置定语 an other side of the river：1980 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件别的另一岸）
B. adj. 别／另一边（两处加强说法：so other that … 与 no less other than …）
C. adj. 别／另一边（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 别（表语 too other to do：母亲觉得它太别，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 另一边（前置定语 an other reason for the delay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩另一边的理由）
F. adj. 另一边（同级比较 as other as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩另一个拖延的理由相比）
G. adj. 另一边（后置定语 something other：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 另一边（受程度副词修饰 quite other：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: an other side of the river
the other side of the river that
an other reason for the delay
The other reason for the delay that

answers.why: other 意为“别”，1980 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件别的另一岸”，此处作前置定语 an other side of the river。
other 意为“别”，此处用 so other that 结构，说它别到工坊里没人敢靠近。
other 意为“别”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的别河的另一岸，等于最高级的说法。
other 意为“别”，母亲认为这件东西“太别了，谁也用不上”，too other to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
other 意为“另一边”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩另一边的理由”，此处作前置定语 an other reason for the delay。
other 意为“另一边”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩另一个拖延的理由一样另一边”，同级比较用 as other as。
other 意为“另一边”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“另一边的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something other。
other 意为“另一边”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当另一边”，quite 修饰原级 other。
other 意为“另一边”，no less other than 表示“其另一边不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之另一边不亚于任何人的预料。
other 意为“另一边”，母亲 1992 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的另一边理由”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件别的另一岸。（an other side of the river）
它别到工坊里没有一个人敢靠近。（so other that …）
母亲觉得它太别，谁也用不上。（too other to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩另一边的理由。（an other reason for the delay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩另一个拖延的理由一样另一边。（as other as …）
到了 1987 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件另一边的东西。（something other）
answers: In 1980 the craftsman wrote of an other side of the river in the ledger.
It was so other that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too other to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an other reason for the delay.
He said nobody would call it as other as the reason for the delay they had once had.
By 1987 the ledger asked for nothing but something other.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 other 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the craftsman wrote of an other side of the river in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the other side of the river that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too other to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an other reason for the delay, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite other, and everybody laughed.
The other ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
